note: Precinct split by Kylee, 27 Nov 2026, from her sketch. District edges from canon Sheet S3: x 26.658 to 29.638 km, y 0 to the starboard net edge. Lines set so each precinct has the area Kylee gave. Proposed, awaiting Jordan. Precinct plan approved as canon by Jordan, 27 Nov 2026.

precincts.name: Grand Canal
precincts.intro: 547 × 5,488 m. Runs the full width of the district, from the Keelway side to the starboard edge, between the bow and stern bands. Eight blocks B1 to B8, port to starboard, cut on the lane lines so none is over 1 km.

buildings.name: Grand Canal
buildings.size_text: 328 ft (100 m) wide, 2,461 ft (750 m) long, widening to 459 ft (140 m); 893,940 sq ft (83,050 m²)
buildings.notes: Plot PG-01. 100 m channel at X 223.5–323.5, widening to 140 m (X 203.5–343.5) between Y 155 and 425 on the west side and Y 155 and 365 on the east. Continues into B2 at 100 m wide. The map draws the widenings as rectangles; the exact outline is in the 2D plan.
buildings.purpose: The Grand Canal, the waterway at the centre of Canal Gardens. Boats carry people along it and the gardens, dining and promenades of the district face onto it.

buildings.name: Grand Entrance Plaza
buildings.notes: Plot PG-02. X 18–193.5, Y 0–195. Plot only, nothing designed on it yet.
buildings.purpose: The main entrance plaza to Canal Gardens, where visitors arrive and get their first view down the Grand Canal.

buildings.name: Main Passenger Terminal
buildings.notes: Plot PG-03. X 18–193.5, Y 195–410. Plot only, building not designed yet.
buildings.purpose: The passenger terminal for Canal Gardens, where visitors arriving in the district start their journey along the canal.

buildings.name: Gateway Gardens
buildings.notes: Plot PG-04. X 18–193.5, Y 410–610. Plot only, nothing designed on it yet.
buildings.purpose: Gardens at the gateway to the district, greeting visitors as they come in from the terminal.

buildings.name: Canal Operations
buildings.notes: Plot PG-05. X 18–193.5, Y 610–750. Plot only, building not designed yet.
buildings.purpose: The office that runs the Grand Canal: boat services, water levels, the bridges and canal maintenance.

buildings.name: Welcome Gardens
buildings.notes: Plot PG-06. X 353.5–529, Y 0–155. Plot only, nothing designed on it yet.
buildings.purpose: Gardens on the far bank at the district entrance, welcoming people as they cross the canal.

buildings.name: Waterfront Dining
buildings.notes: Plot PG-07. X 353.5–529, Y 155–330. Plot only, building not designed yet.
buildings.purpose: Restaurants and cafés on the canal front, where people eat looking out over the water.

buildings.name: Public Boat Stop
buildings.notes: Plot PG-08. X 353.5–529, Y 330–430. Plot only, nothing designed on it yet.
buildings.purpose: A public boat stop where people get on and off the canal boats.

buildings.name: Recreation Park
buildings.notes: Plot PG-09. X 353.5–529, Y 430–665. Plot only, nothing designed on it yet.
buildings.purpose: A park for play and recreation beside the canal.

buildings.name: Emergency Services
buildings.notes: Plot PG-10. X 353.5–529, Y 665–750. Plot only, building not designed yet.
buildings.purpose: The emergency services post for Canal Gardens, covering fire, rescue and first aid along the canal.

buildings.name: Promenades
buildings.size_text: 98 ft (30 m) wide along the canal, 33 ft (10 m) at the widenings; 397,730 sq ft (36,950 m²)
buildings.notes: Plot PG-11. The land between the canal and the plots at X 193.5 and X 353.5. The map draws it as six rectangles and leaves out four small corner triangles (1,550 m²) beside the widenings; the exact outline is in the 2D plan.
buildings.purpose: Walkways along both banks of the canal, where people stroll between the gardens, dining and boat stops.

buildings.name: Access Road A
buildings.notes: Plot PG-12A. X 0–18, Y 0–750, along the bow edge of B1. Proposed infrastructure.
buildings.purpose: The service road along the bow edge of the district, keeping deliveries and vehicles away from the canal front.

buildings.name: Access Road B
buildings.notes: Plot PG-12B. X 529–547, Y 0–750, along the stern edge of B1. Proposed infrastructure.
buildings.purpose: The service road along the stern edge of the district.

buildings.name: Gateway Bridge
buildings.notes: Pedestrian bridge over the canal. X 183.5–363.5, Y 135–155. Each end overlaps its plot by 10 m (PG-02 and PG-06).
buildings.purpose: A footbridge over the canal by the entrance, linking the two banks.

buildings.name: Garden Bridge
buildings.notes: Pedestrian bridge over the canal. X 183.5–363.5, Y 550–570. Each end overlaps its plot by 10 m (PG-04 and PG-09).
buildings.purpose: A footbridge over the canal by the gardens, linking the two banks.

buildings.name: Grand Canal (B2)
buildings.notes: Plot WR-01. X 223.5–323.5, Y 0–500, straight 100 m channel. Continues the B1 canal (100 m at its Y 750 edge) without a step and runs on into B3.
buildings.purpose: The second stretch of the Grand Canal, running on through the Waterfront Quarter.

buildings.name: Riverside Dining
buildings.notes: Plot WR-02. X 18–193.5, Y 0–160. Plot only, nothing designed on it yet.
buildings.purpose: Riverside restaurants along the second stretch of the canal.

buildings.name: Culinary Market
buildings.notes: Plot WR-03. X 18–193.5, Y 160–290. Plot only, nothing designed on it yet.
buildings.purpose: A food market where people buy and taste food from across the ship.

buildings.name: Waterfront Social Gardens
buildings.notes: Plot WR-04. X 18–193.5, Y 290–430. Plot only, nothing designed on it yet.
buildings.purpose: Gardens beside the water for gatherings, picnics and events.

buildings.name: Public Boat Stop (B2)
buildings.notes: Plot WR-05. X 18–193.5, Y 430–500. Plot only, nothing designed on it yet.
buildings.purpose: A second public boat stop, serving the waterfront.

buildings.name: Canal Terrace Gardens
buildings.notes: Plot WR-06. X 353.5–529, Y 0–110. Plot only, nothing designed on it yet.
buildings.purpose: Terraced gardens stepping down to the canal.

buildings.name: Waterfront Restaurants
buildings.notes: Plot WR-07. X 353.5–529, Y 110–295. Plot only, nothing designed on it yet.
buildings.purpose: A row of restaurants on the waterfront.

buildings.name: Fountain Square
buildings.notes: Plot WR-08. X 353.5–529, Y 295–410. Plot only, nothing designed on it yet.
buildings.purpose: A square with a fountain, a meeting place on the waterfront.

buildings.name: Sunset Terraces
buildings.notes: Plot WR-09. X 353.5–529, Y 410–500. Plot only, nothing designed on it yet.
buildings.purpose: Terraces facing along the canal where people gather to watch the evening light.

buildings.name: Promenades (B2)
buildings.notes: WR-10A X 193.5–223.5 and WR-10B X 323.5–353.5, both Y 0–500. They carry on from the B1 promenades (30 m at B1's Y 750 edge) and run on into B3.
buildings.purpose: Walkways along both banks of the second stretch of the canal.

buildings.name: Access Road A (B2)
buildings.notes: Plot WR-11A. X 0–18, Y 0–500, along the bow edge of B2. Carries on from B1's Access Road A. Proposed infrastructure.
buildings.purpose: The service road along the bow edge of the waterfront stretch.

buildings.name: Access Road B (B2)
buildings.notes: Plot WR-11B. X 529–547, Y 0–500, along the stern edge of B2. Carries on from B1's Access Road B. Proposed infrastructure.
buildings.purpose: The service road along the stern edge of the waterfront stretch.

buildings.name: Social Bridge
buildings.notes: Pedestrian bridge over the canal. X 183.5–363.5, Y 250–266. Each end overlaps its plot by 10 m (WR-03, WR-07).
buildings.purpose: A footbridge over the canal linking the social gardens and restaurants on either bank.

buildings.name: Grand Canal (B3)
buildings.notes: Plot WR2-01. X 223.5–323.5, Y 0–500, straight 100 m channel. Continues the B2 canal (100 m at its Y 500 edge) without a step and runs on into B4.
buildings.purpose: The third stretch of the Grand Canal, carrying boats on through the Waterfront Quarter towards the Central Canal.

buildings.name: Artisan Market
buildings.notes: Plot WR2-02. X 18–193.5, Y 0–140. Plot only, nothing designed on it yet.
buildings.purpose: A market where makers and craftspeople sell what they make: pottery, textiles, glass and woodwork.

buildings.name: Cultural Courtyard
buildings.notes: Plot WR2-03. X 18–193.5, Y 140–245. Plot only, nothing designed on it yet. The west end of the Heritage Bridge lands here.
buildings.purpose: An open courtyard for performances, exhibitions and cultural events, with the Heritage Bridge arriving at its canal side.

buildings.name: Sculpture Gardens
buildings.notes: Plot WR2-04. X 18–193.5, Y 245–400. Plot only, nothing designed on it yet.
buildings.purpose: Gardens for walking among sculpture, with paths and benches beside the canal.

buildings.name: Waterside Café Terraces
buildings.notes: Plot WR2-05. X 18–193.5, Y 400–500. Plot only, nothing designed on it yet.
buildings.purpose: Cafés with outdoor terraces facing the canal, for coffee and light meals.

buildings.name: Canal Amphitheatre
buildings.notes: Plot WR2-06. X 353.5–529, Y 0–145. Plot only, nothing designed on it yet.
buildings.purpose: An outdoor amphitheatre by the canal for concerts, plays and public events.

buildings.name: Reflection Gardens
buildings.notes: Plot WR2-07. X 353.5–529, Y 145–265. Plot only, nothing designed on it yet. The east end of the Heritage Bridge lands here.
buildings.purpose: Quiet gardens for sitting and resting, laid out to look over the water.

buildings.name: Floating Market Landing
buildings.notes: Plot WR2-08. X 353.5–529, Y 265–370. Plot only, nothing designed on it yet.
buildings.purpose: The landing where market boats tie up and sell from the water to people on the bank.

buildings.name: Waterfront Picnic Park
buildings.notes: Plot WR2-09. X 353.5–529, Y 370–500. Plot only, nothing designed on it yet.
buildings.purpose: A park with lawns and tables for families and groups to picnic beside the canal.

buildings.name: Promenades (B3)
buildings.notes: WR2-10A X 193.5–223.5 and WR2-10B X 323.5–353.5, both Y 0–500. They carry on from the B2 promenades (30 m at B2's Y 500 edge) and run on into B4.
buildings.purpose: Walkways along both banks of the third stretch of the canal.

buildings.name: Access Road A (B3)
buildings.notes: Plot WR2-11A. X 0–18, Y 0–500, along the bow edge of B3. Carries on from B2's Access Road A. Proposed infrastructure.
buildings.purpose: The service road along the bow edge of the waterfront stretch.

buildings.name: Access Road B (B3)
buildings.notes: Plot WR2-11B. X 529–547, Y 0–500, along the stern edge of B3. Carries on from B2's Access Road B. Proposed infrastructure.
buildings.purpose: The service road along the stern edge of the waterfront stretch.

buildings.name: Heritage Bridge
buildings.notes: Pedestrian bridge over the canal. X 183.5–363.5, Y 220–236. Each end overlaps its plot by 10 m (WR2-03, WR2-07).
buildings.purpose: A footbridge over the canal linking the Cultural Courtyard and the Reflection Gardens.

blocks.label: B1
blocks.name: Port Gateway
blocks.notes: Layout proposed: nine plots, the Grand Canal, promenades, two access roads and two pedestrian bridges. Block is 547 × 750 m (410,250 m²) including the two edge roads.

blocks.label: B2
blocks.name: Waterfront Reach I
blocks.notes: Layout proposed: nine plots, the canal, two promenades, two boundary access roads and the Social Bridge. Block is 547 × 500 m (273,500 m²) including the two edge roads.

blocks.label: B3
blocks.name: Waterfront Reach II
blocks.notes: Layout proposed: nine plots, the canal, two promenades, two boundary access roads and the Heritage Bridge. Block is 547 × 500 m (273,500 m²) including the two edge roads.

precincts.name: Waterfront Quarter
precincts.intro: 1,002 × 2,495 m. Stern band, port side, on the stern bank of the Grand Canal.

precincts.name: Botanical Gardens
precincts.intro: 1,002 × 2,993 m. Stern band, starboard side, out to the starboard edge.

precincts.name: Garden Squares
precincts.exclude_note: Atrium Plaza (canon) is not part of the precinct
precincts.intro: 1,431 × 2,345 m, less the canon Atrium Plaza, which cuts its port-bow corner. Bow band, port side.

precincts.name: Canal Village
precincts.intro: 1,431 × 1,398 m. Bow band, starboard side, out to the starboard edge.
